conventions.convention: Signature is (-,+,+,+), x⁰=ct_K uses length coordinates, ξ=∂x⁰ selects the future orientation, u=ξ/N is the observer field, and ϑ=NT is redshifted temperature.
The spatial domain is a rectangular box with Euclidean volume and outward face normals. Positive C² initial data must admit a bounded positive even extension with periods 2L_i.
Conductivity is A₀/N, physical heat flux is q=cQ, insulation means N²q·ν=0, and external support f=∇·𝕋 must satisfy u_bfᵇ=0.
The mathematical supplier chain assumes Countable Choice. Conclusions concern the adopted supported parabolic model and use no empirical data.

load_bearing.statement: Adopt q=−(A₀/N)(∇ₓT+T∇ₓlog N), NC_V∂t_K T+divₓ(N²q)=0, and N²q·ν=0 on each face, with the stated static geometry, material state, positive compatible initial data, and no-local-power external support.

Under the specified supported static heat model, the unique solution has the displayed Gaussian representation, positive bounds, conserved lapse-weighted energy, entropy rate A₀∫Ω|∇ₓϑ|²/ϑ² dx≥0, and exponential L² relaxation of ϑ to its initial mean; T converges in L² to that mean divided by N.
